description: This Java class defines an Android activity that enables drag-and-drop reordering of list items within a ListView. It initializes a list of cheese names, sets up an adapter, and configures a custom ListView for touch-based reordering animations.

classes.name: ListViewDraggingAnimation
classes.description: Main activity class managing the list view with drag-and-drop reordering functionality.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle callback that initializes the activity, sets up the list data, and configures the ListView for drag-and-drop reordering.
